ctest.failure_cause: Tokenizer test cloned Git LFS pointer files because git-lfs is not installed. Downloaded the 11 actual vocabulary files and verified each against its pointer SHA256.

fixes_in_candidate: Preserve mandatory SenseNova loop and mHC metadata when saving models.
Validate loop metadata and use 64-bit expanded-layer-count arithmetic to reject overflow.
Crop final-layer outputs after merging mHC streams when the loop reaches the final layer.

performance_smoke.interpretation: No clear slowdown outside measured run variation; small-fixture smoke test only.

limitations: CPU-only regression validation of this upstream candidate; CUDA, Metal and Vulkan not tested.
Other-architecture before/after comparisons use small synthetic fixtures, not full production checkpoints.
No full-model perplexity benchmark or full cross-platform CI matrix completed.
note: CPU validation for the separate upstream candidate, not the older LM Studio recipe. Raw local logs are not included in this repository.
